prompt: 12 distinct top-down RPG trees in 4x3 cells, transparent; LPC scale/style reference; oak, birch, pine, juniper, willow, alder, maple, golden birch, rowan, beech, fir, gnarled oak.
processing: Trim individual cells, nearest fit 88x112, transparent 96x128 canvas, root baseline 120. Existing native LPC young trees and plants are cropped without recoloring.
